scripts.build: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run tokens:build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node ./scripts/bundle_renderer.mjs && node ./scripts/copy_static.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run tokens:build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node ./scripts/bundle_renderer.mjs && node ./scripts/copy_static.mjs && concurrently "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch" "tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit --watch" "node ./scripts/watch_renderer.mjs" "pnpm run copy:watch" "node ./scripts/start_electron_hot.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:debug: pnpm run build && playwright test -c playwright.config.ts --debug
scripts.test:e2e:headed: pnpm run build && playwright test -c playwright.config.ts --headed
scripts.test:e2e:ui: pnpm run build && playwright test -c playwright.config.ts --ui
scripts.test:node: node --test tests/schedule-preserve.test.mjs tests/load-state-recovery.test.mjs tests/init-startup-autoplan.test.mjs tests/contracts-planner-validation.test.mjs tests/state-store-json-atomic.test.mjs tests/state-store-sqlite.test.mjs tests/state-store-migration.test.mjs tests/state-recover.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
